claim_legs.durability: Prospective source pins and exact Git-bound dependencies, first-run observations and complete recovery manifests are tracked. Saved-only audit and recovery authenticate without fixture replay or original raw-log access. The book disposition names its explicit watcher.
claim_legs.falsify: Unchanged recursive source-scope and independent healthy-prefix/remaining-owner oracles agree before and after execution. Row/domain/header controls reject altered evidence, including collapsed equal sources, changed shared archive identity and false profile selection. Recovery-copy and book-count controls reject omissions, wrong destinations/digests and outcome redistribution.
claim_legs.rederive: Committed selectors define the exact equal-reference domain. Immutable case receipts preserve actual calls, close returns, reported errors, inactive attempts, file effects and cleanup. The original equal-identity oracle reconstructs source bytes and native identities from initial files. The book watcher independently recounts original cases and TAP.

commit_gate: Staged doctrines and normal commit hooks must pass before commit.
limits: Active-runtime, last-observation, primary/grouped errors, genuine omissions, final release applicability and native/lifetime remain separate. No earlier qualifier, fixture, original main or native process is replayed. Historical startup/parent/full CI/push remain gated.
scope: Equal-reference healthy control and every selected single EIO close report. Actual close success and native closure precede substitution. Original equal-byte source identities and shared archived identity remain distinct facts.
